paragraphs: He reports Rabbi Shimon Chasida: Bava Kamma 113b.[^1]

notes.text: The supplied notice spells שמון. The stored William Davidson Edition of Bava Kamma 113b explicitly has Rav Bivi bar Giddel reporting Rabbi Shimon Chasida (שמעון חסידא). That exact chain supports Shimon and Rabbi for this occurrence; the supplied spelling remains visible in this note, without a printed-text or correction-history claim.
